"world_consistency" carries no "decision" field at all — list every claim in "claims" (empty list if the response makes none); "quote" is required (a non-empty, verbatim, word-for-word fragment of the response, never null) on every claim and is written before "claim"; "checked_against" is required (a non-empty string, never null) on every claim. When "consistent" is false it must name the specific fact the claim conflicts with. When "consistent" is true it may cite a supporting fact, or must be exactly "No supplied fact addresses this claim." when no supplied fact addresses the claim at all.
